split.contaminated: the held-out list and the learner were written by the same board 35 builder, and the learner was revised (the strict contradiction rule, the retractions, the support gate) after the (b) and (c) held-out counts of earlier runs were printed and read (the loop the item allows: edit and re-run on (b) and (c) only); one scratch check during the first design parsed the first 2000 train questions, held-out included (no gold read, nothing learned). ceiling.what: board 36, item learn-2: the ceiling by cause over the development rows (self/learn.mjs ceilingByCause, CAUSES), before and after the straight-line programs read from the worked chains (self/learn.mjs CHAIN, reason/induce.mjs chainProgram)

causes.name: word quantity
causes.what: the gold needs a number the prompt does not write: no whole program over its own leaves gives the gold (search, at most MAX_OPS operations; with the chain programs on, not its own chain program either), and one does once the word quantities its prompt admits (reason/induce.mjs wordQuantities) are added as leaves

causes.name: chain too long
causes.what: the worked chain, read as a straight-line program over the prompt numbers and earlier steps (reason/induce.mjs chainProgram), runs on the prompt numbers to the gold but needs more operations than the arm admits: MAX_OPS (4) with the search programs only, CHAIN.maxOps (8) with the chain programs on

causes.name: number from the text
causes.what: a number of the worked chain is not a quantity of the prompt, a named leaf or an earlier step (it comes from the text), so the chain does not run on the prompt numbers

causes.name: pattern
causes.what: the chain runs on the prompt numbers to the gold within the operations the arm admits, yet no program of another development row of its role pattern gives its gold: the parse reads a quantity the chain never uses (gate 5 refuses such a program), the parse holds more leaves than the search window (12, gate 5 again), its role form is its own (no other development row shares it; gate 7 answers a learned entry only in a form it fit), or the rows that share it offer no program that gives its gold

causes.name: other
causes.what: the answer has no annotated step, a step is not plain arithmetic, the gold is a quantity the prompt writes, or the chain reads every number yet no step of it computes the gold on the prompt numbers

chainRule.what: a straight-line program read from the worked chain of a development row (reason/induce.mjs chainProgram): at most 8 operations, it reads every positional quantity, and it runs on the row's own leaves to its gold
